# An async.query under an `if` reading the state of a component that is
# itself built at run time, under an `if` of its own: the shape of a detail
# page asking for a second answer keyed on the first. Its unbound two-way
# props are cells of a wrapper ImplicitState writes, and query's family is its
# type parameter F, which the call site leaves to the position: the wrapper
# had no family, and once built at run time with the query's effect in it no
# pass could type its root. It is a member of the family the position takes.
#
# The fetch waits on a request to the script harness's server, and html's
# factory for a component built at run time wrote each of its functions
# without its colour: the query's mount, which awaits, was a sync function
# holding an `await`, which esbuild refused.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import http "sngl:http"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

func lookup(k string) async.Result[string] {
    match var r = http.get(url="http://127.0.0.1:47819/status/200") {
        failed { return {failed=r} }
        ok { return {ok=r.status == 200 ? k + "!" : "-"} }
    }
}

component second(s string) ui.node {
    var first = ""
    var answer option[string] = null
    if first != "" {
        async.query(on=first, fetch=lookup, :value=answer)
    }
    ui.button #ask(text="ask", @click { first = s })
    ui.text(value=answer != null ? answer : "-")
}

component page ui.node {
    var open = false
    if open {
        second #inner(s="b")
    }
    ui.button #show(text="show", @click { open = true })
}

func testTheSecondQueryAnswers(t test.Test, c page) {
    c.show.click()
    t.assert(c.inner != null)
    if c.inner != null {
        c.inner.ask.click()
        t.wait(func() => c.inner != null && c.inner.answer == "b!", 5000)
        t.assert(c.inner.answer == "b!")
    }
}

ui.window {
    page()
}
